title: ID0483947-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S2 170003123] Charger Operation Mode
description:
Reported behavior/issue- Charger Operation Mode
Maintenance mode was enabled on 02/03 and charger was inoperational since. Disabled the maintenance mode and charger returned to operational in power saving mode

additional_info.subject: ID0483947-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S2 170003123] Charger Operation Mode CRM:03056001109
additional_info.body:
Dear Alexandra,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support, I hope this email finds you well.
After looking into the charger's logs we can see that a maintenance mode was enabled which was preventing the charger from operating. Through the logs we cannot see whether this mode was initiated locally or remotely as you asked, but I have stopped the maintenance mode on our side and the charger should be operational now in power save mode.
Please confirm on your side that the charger is operational and if we can proceed to close the case.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Cecilia Pacheco
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
